evidence: Liv. 1.18.6: in lapide ad merīdiem versus cōnsēdit (Lewis & Short s.v. vertō)
terms.comment: Versus here is an adverb, “turned towards”, added to ad or in with the accusative; so ad septentriōnēs versus, northward.
The construction is classical (in forum versus, Cic. Lael. 96, Lewis & Short s.v. vertō). Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
